audience: field service business owners and dispatchers who run jobs and leads in Workiz

useCases.title: Show open jobs with schedule and assigned team
useCases.text: The AI lists open jobs, filtered by start date and status, and opens one for the client, address, amount due, notes and assigned team.

useCases.title: Review new leads from the last days
useCases.text: The AI lists open leads by start date and status, and opens one for the source, notes and contact. You see which leads need a follow-up.

useCases.title: Check team skills and time off before scheduling
useCases.text: The AI lists team members with role, service areas and skills, and future time off for one person or for the whole business.

useCases.title: Create or update jobs and assign or unassign technicians
useCases.text: The AI creates a job or changes the status, time, address or notes of one. It assigns or unassigns a team member by name.

useCases.title: Add leads, convert them to jobs, or mark them lost or active
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead with contact, source and notes. It converts a lead to a job, marks it as lost, or reactivates a lost lead.
